snippet.title: 1666: Amsterdam - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into 1666: Amsterdam for the first time.

The free Prologue is now live on Steam and Epic Games Store.

-

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4519690/1666_Amsterdam__Prologue/
Epic Game Store : https://store.epicgames.com/p/1666-amsterdam-1666-amsterdam-prologue-ec3a88

Wishlist the full game and follow its development toward Early Access on PC later in 2026.

-

About 1666: Amsterdam 
A cycle is ending. Another one is beginning.
Take part in Noa’s Commencement as she inherits the mantle of the Collector.
Unravel a mystery that spans centuries. Choose the companion that will walk beside you. Follow the traces left behind in a city shaped by secrets, power, and memory.
This is where everything begins.

-
